title: CrowdAlert
description: One alert record emitted by the risk agent for one zone. The dashboard consumes this; the vision pipeline never sees it.

alert_id.description: UUID v4 — unique per emitted alert

ts.description: UTC time of the reading that triggered this alert

level.description: Risk level assigned by the rule engine. The LLM can never downgrade this.

density_ppm2.description: Instantaneous density from the zone reading

density_trend_per_min.description: Linear density change per minute over the last 60 s window. Negative = crowd thinning.

triggered_by.description: Which rule(s) fired. At least one entry.

reason.description: Plain-English explanation written by the rule engine or LLM, stating facts only.

evidence_frame.description: Optional. Path/key of the annotated frame, faces blurred.

requires_approval.description: True when level is warning or critical — operator must act.

escalate_after_s.description: Seconds before the system re-escalates if not approved. Only present when requires_approval is true.
